user.title: Add to Floor Heating
user.description: Add a room, or the house Master that sends the mode (Occupied/Unoccupied/Frost/Off) to all rooms. There can be only one Master.

room.title: Add a room to the floor heating
room.description: Every room gets its own controller. Add the integration again for each room.

master.title: Master
master.description: The house mode is sent to all rooms, like in IHC. The outdoor sensor is only used if a room has outdoor compensation (ke) above 0.

init.title: Room settings
init.description: When the window is open the output is frozen, so nothing is regulated on the room temperature. Only "Kun Gulv" (floor only) keeps regulating.

data.window_sensor: Window and door contacts (optional, empty = no window rule)
data.max_floor_temp: Max floor temperature (°C) - heating stops above this
data.valve_exercise_days: Valve exercise: open the valve if it has not been open for this many days (0 = off)
data.stale_hours: A sensor without updates for this many hours counts as missing (0 = off)
data.outdoor_ke: Outdoor compensation ke (% output per degree between target and outdoor, 0 = off)

master_options.title: Master
master_options.description: Outdoor sensor for outdoor compensation. Each room picks its own ke.
